title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Operations Standard: Fulfillment, Order Minimums and Club Pickup
content:
This operations standard of Northgate Purchases & Returns governs what each channel accepts, when a purchase counts as fulfilled, and how club pickup and partner-delivered orders are handled.

## 1. Assortment and minimum

Each channel sells everything except the merchandise classes its channel schedule excludes, and accepts an order only when the order's merchandise total — the sum of the line amounts of the items sold on the purchase — reaches the channel's minimum order amount (at or above it).

## 2. The fulfillment date

1. An in-club purchase taken away by the member is fulfilled at the register on its order date.
2. An in-club purchase or special order whose merchandise is booked for a Northgate delivery appointment is fulfilled on the date that delivery is completed.
3. The fulfillment date is the date recorded when the member received the merchandise, and it is the anchor of every window in the Northgate Purchases & Returns charter.

## 3. Club pickup

A club pickup order is held at the club for the channel's pickup hold days, counted as calendar days after the order date, and, if still uncollected, is cancelled and refunded in full. Where the channel allows alternate pickup, a person the member names on the order may collect it with photo ID.

## 4. Partner-fulfilled orders

On a channel fulfilled by a delivery partner, the partner shops, delivers and handles substitutions, missing items and delivery problems on its own app. Member services cannot change, cancel or credit those orders, and their merchandise can only be returned at a club counter.

## Worked readings (hypothetical)

| Situation | Reading under this standard |
|---|---|
| A sofa rung up in club and booked for a Northgate delivery appointment completed eight days later | fulfilled on the delivery completion date, not the order date |
| A club pickup order placed on day 0 on a channel with a 3-day hold, never collected | held through the third calendar day after the order date, then cancelled and refunded in full |
| A same-day delivery order missing one item | handled by the delivery partner on its app; member services does not credit it |
| A basket whose merchandise total equals the channel minimum exactly | accepted, the minimum being reached |
